sentences.zh: 張臣，榆林衞人。

translations.literal: Zhang Chen was a man of Yulin Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Chen was a native of Yulin Guard.

sentences.zh: 起行伍，為隊長。

translations.literal: He rose from the ranks and became a squad leader.
translations.idiomatic: He worked his way up from the ranks to become a squad leader.

sentences.zh: 蹻捷精悍，搏戰好陷堅。

translations.literal: He was nimble, sharp, and resolute, and in close combat he loved to charge hardened positions.
translations.idiomatic: Nimble, tough, and fearless, he excelled in hand-to-hand fighting and delighted in storming the enemy's strongest points.

sentences.zh: 從千總劉朋守黃甫川。

translations.literal: He followed the chiliarch Liu Peng to defend Huangfu River.
translations.idiomatic: He served under the chiliarch Liu Peng in the defense of Huangfu River.

sentences.zh: 朋遇寇喪馬被圍，臣單騎馳救，射中其魁，奪馬載朋歸，由此知名。

translations.literal: When Peng encountered bandits, lost his horse, and was surrounded, Chen rode alone to the rescue, shot the enemy leader, seized a horse and carried Peng back, and thereby made his name known.
translations.idiomatic: When Peng met raiders, lost his mount, and was surrounded, Chen charged in alone, shot down the enemy chieftain, seized a horse, and carried Peng to safety—an exploit that first brought him fame.

sentences.zh: 旋代朋職，屢戰跨馬梁、李家溝、高家堡、田家梁、西紅山，並有功，遷宣府膳房堡守備。

translations.literal: Soon he replaced Peng in his post, fought repeatedly at Kuama Ridge, Lijia Gully, Gaojia Fort, Tianjia Ridge, and Xihong Mountain, distinguishing himself each time, and was transferred to be garrison commander at Shanfang Fort in Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: He soon succeeded to Peng's command and fought repeatedly at Kuama Ridge, Lijia Gully, Gaojia Fort, Tianjia Ridge, and Xihong Mountain, winning credit in every engagement before being appointed garrison commander at Shanfang Fort in Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 寇嘗大入，環攻堡，欲生得臣。

translations.literal: The bandits once made a major incursion, surrounded the fort on all sides, and wished to take Chen alive.
translations.idiomatic: On one major raid the enemy surrounded the fort and tried to capture Chen alive.

sentences.zh: 臣召麾下酌水為酒，歡呼歌飲，寇莫測所為，不敢登。

translations.literal: Chen summoned his men, poured water as though it were wine, and drank and sang with shouts of joy; the bandits could not fathom what he was doing and did not dare climb up.
translations.idiomatic: Chen called his men together, toasted them with water passed off as wine, and led them in boisterous song and drink; baffled by his behavior, the raiders did not dare scale the walls.

sentences.zh: 臣夜決圍出，取他道以歸。

translations.literal: At night Chen broke through the encirclement and returned by another route.
translations.idiomatic: That night he broke out of the siege and made his way back by another road.

sentences.zh: 上官壯之，擢延綏入衞遊擊將軍。

translations.literal: His superiors admired him and promoted him to mobile corps commander of the Yan-sui Inner Guard.
translations.idiomatic: His superiors were impressed and promoted him to mobile corps commander of the Yan-sui Inner Guard.

sentences.zh: 隆慶元年九月，土蠻大入昌黎、撫寧、樂亭、盧龍，遊騎至灤河。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the first year of Longqing, Tumen made a major incursion into Changli, Funing, Leting, and Lulong, and his scouting horsemen reached the Luan River.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the first year of Longqing (1567), Tumen launched a major raid into Changli, Funing, Leting, and Lulong, and his scouting parties reached the Luan River.

sentences.zh: 諸將莫敢戰，臣獨勒兵赴之。

translations.literal: None of the generals dared give battle; Chen alone marshaled his troops and went to meet them.
translations.idiomatic: None of the other commanders dared engage the enemy; Chen alone gathered his force and marched to meet them.

sentences.zh: 遼帥王治道曰：「敵衆我寡，往必無利。」

translations.literal: The Liaodong commander Wang Zhidao said, "The enemy are many and we are few; if we go, it will surely bring no gain.
translations.idiomatic: The Liaodong commander Wang Zhidao warned him, "They outnumber us; if you go, you will gain nothing.

sentences.zh: 臣不顧，率所部千人擐甲直馳，呼聲震山谷，寇以數騎嘗，奮前斬之。

translations.literal: Chen paid no heed, led his thousand men in armor straight forward, and his shouts shook the valleys; the bandits sent a few horsemen to test him, and he pressed forward eagerly and cut them down.
translations.idiomatic: Chen ignored the warning, led his thousand armored men straight at the enemy, and his battle cry echoed through the valleys. When the raiders sent out a few horsemen to probe him, he charged forward and cut them down.

sentences.zh: 追至棒槌崖，斬首百十餘級，墜崖死傷者無算。

translations.literal: He pursued them to Bangchui Cliff, beheaded more than a hundred and ten, and those who fell from the cliff and were killed or wounded were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: He pursued them to Bangchui Cliff, took more than a hundred and ten heads, and countless others fell from the cliffs to their deaths.

sentences.zh: 事寧，薊鎮諸將悉獲罪，臣以功增秩二級。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled, the generals of Jizhen were all punished, while Chen was raised two ranks for his merit.
translations.idiomatic: When the crisis ended, the Jizhen commanders were all punished, but Chen was promoted two ranks for his service.

sentences.zh: 無何，寇潛入場子嶺，參將吳昂被殺，命臣代之。

translations.literal: Before long the bandits slipped into Changzi Ridge; the assistant commander Wu Ang was killed, and Chen was ordered to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward raiders infiltrated Changzi Ridge; the assistant commander Wu Ang was killed, and Chen was appointed in his place.

sentences.zh: 尋進副總兵，領總督標下事，改守薊鎮西協。

translations.literal: He was soon advanced to deputy commander-in-chief, took charge of the governor-general's personal command, and was reassigned to defend the western sector of Jizhen.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to deputy commander-in-chief, placed in charge of the governor-general's personal staff, and reassigned to the western sector of Jizhen.

sentences.zh: 萬曆初，錄秋防功，進署都督僉事。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Wanli reign, his autumn-defense merits were recorded and he was advanced to acting regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Wanli reign his autumn-defense service was recognized and he was appointed acting regional commander.

sentences.zh: 炒蠻潛入古北口，參將范宗儒追至十八盤山，戰歿，餘衆被圍。

translations.literal: Chaoman slipped into Gubeikou; the assistant commander Fan Zongru pursued them to Eighteen-Plateau Mountain, died in battle, and the remainder of his force was surrounded.
translations.idiomatic: Chaoman infiltrated Gubeikou; the assistant commander Fan Zongru pursued them to Eighteen-Plateau Mountain, was killed in action, and the survivors were surrounded.

sentences.zh: 臣急偕遊擊高廷禮等馳救，寇始去，坐鐫一秩。

translations.literal: Chen hastened with the mobile corps commander Gao Tingli and others to the rescue; only then did the bandits withdraw, but he was demoted one rank for the affair.
translations.idiomatic: Chen rushed to the rescue with the mobile corps commander Gao Tingli and others, and the raiders finally withdrew; nevertheless he was demoted one rank for the losses incurred.

sentences.zh: 五年春，以總兵官鎮守寧夏。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fifth year he was made commander-in-chief and garrisoned Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fifth year (1577) he was appointed commander-in-chief and posted to Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 順義王俺答報怨瓦剌，欲取道賀蘭，臣不可，俺答恚，語不遜。

translations.literal: The Shunyi Prince Altan, nursing a grudge against the Oirats, wished to pass through Helan; Chen refused permission, Altan grew angry, and his words were disrespectful.
translations.idiomatic: The Shunyi Prince Altan, seeking revenge against the Oirats, asked to march through Helan; Chen refused, and Altan grew furious and spoke insolently.

sentences.zh: 臣夜決漢、唐二渠水，道不通，復陳兵赤水口，俺答乃從山後去。

translations.literal: At night Chen diverted the waters of the Han and Tang canals so that the route was impassable, then arrayed troops at Chishui Pass; only then did Altan go around by the rear of the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Chen diverted the Han and Tang canal waters by night, blocking the route, then deployed troops at Chishui Pass; Altan was forced to withdraw by the mountain rear.

sentences.zh: 三歲互市，毋敢譁者。

translations.literal: For three years at the border markets no one dared make a disturbance.
translations.idiomatic: For three years the border markets remained peaceful and no one dared cause trouble.

sentences.zh: 閱邊給事中以苛禮責望，劾罷之。

translations.literal: A touring frontier censor impeached him for demanding excessive courtesy and had him dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: A touring frontier censor impeached him for insisting on excessive ceremony and had him removed from office.

sentences.zh: 十一年，小阿卜戶犯黑峪關，守將陳文治以下俱逮繫。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Xiao Aihu raided Heiyu Pass, and the defending commander Chen Wenzhi and those below him were all arrested.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year (1583) Xiao Aihu raided Heiyu Pass, and the defending commander Chen Wenzhi and his subordinates were all arrested.

sentences.zh: 詔起臣副總兵，駐守馬蘭峪。

translations.literal: An edict recalled Chen as deputy commander-in-chief to garrison Malan Valley.
translations.idiomatic: An edict recalled Chen to serve as deputy commander-in-chief and garrison Malan Valley.

sentences.zh: 會朶顏長昂屢擾邊，薊鎮總兵官楊四畏不能禦，乃調四畏保定，而徙臣代之。

translations.literal: As it happened, Duoyan Chang Ang had repeatedly harassed the frontier, and the Jizhen commander-in-chief Yang Siwei could not repel him; Yang was therefore transferred to Baoding and Chen was moved to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: Duoyan Chang Ang had been raiding the frontier repeatedly, and the Jizhen commander Yang Siwei could not stop him; Yang was transferred to Baoding and Chen was moved in to replace him.

sentences.zh: 長昂雅憚臣，使其從母土阿、妻東桂款關乞降，乃撫賞如初。

translations.literal: Chang Ang had long feared Chen; he sent his father's younger brother's wife Tu'a and his wife Donggui to present themselves at the pass and beg to surrender, and they were pacified and rewarded as before.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Ang had always feared Chen; he sent his stepmother Tu'a and his wife Donggui to the pass to sue for peace, and they were pacified and rewarded as before.

sentences.zh: 猛可真者，俺答弟老把都棄妾也，坐與小阿卜戶犯黑峪關，罷歲賞。

translations.literal: Mengke Zhen was a discarded concubine of Altan's younger brother Laobadou; because she had joined Xiao Aihu in raiding Heiyu Pass, the annual reward was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Mengke Zhen was a discarded concubine of Altan's younger brother Laobadou; for aiding Xiao Aihu in the Heiyu Pass raid, her annual stipend was cut off.

sentences.zh: 既納款，復猖獗，以謾詞報邊臣，而令大嬖只代為謝罪。

translations.literal: After she had submitted, she again grew violent, answered the frontier officials with deceitful words, and had Dabiji act as her proxy to apologize.
translations.idiomatic: After submitting she grew defiant again, answered the frontier officials with evasive words, and sent Dabiji to apologize on her behalf.

sentences.zh: 大嬖只者，順義王乞慶哈棄妾也。

translations.literal: Dabiji was a discarded concubine of the Shunyi Prince Qiqingha.
translations.idiomatic: Dabiji was a discarded concubine of the Shunyi Prince Qiqingha.

sentences.zh: 臣等測其詐，令將士出塞捕二十三人，繫之獄，令還我被掠人。

translations.literal: Chen and the others perceived their deceit, ordered troops beyond the pass to seize twenty-three persons, imprisoned them, and demanded the return of our captured people.
translations.idiomatic: Chen and his colleagues saw through the ruse, sent troops beyond the pass to seize twenty-three people, imprisoned them, and demanded the return of captives taken from Ming territory.

sentences.zh: 猛可真以所愛者五人在俘中，許獻還所掠，親叩關索故賞。

translations.literal: Mengke Zhen, because five of those she loved were among the prisoners, promised to return what had been seized and came in person to the pass to ask for her former reward.
translations.idiomatic: Five of Mengke Zhen's favorites were among the prisoners; she promised to return the plunder and came in person to the pass to beg for restoration of her former stipend.

sentences.zh: 臣等并召大嬖只入演武場，譙責甚厲。

translations.literal: Chen and the others also summoned Dabiji into the drill ground and rebuked her severely.
translations.idiomatic: Chen and his colleagues also summoned Dabiji to the drill ground and rebuked her harshly.

sentences.zh: 兩婦叩頭請死，乃貸之。

translations.literal: The two women kowtowed and begged for death, whereupon they were spared.
translations.idiomatic: Both women kowtowed and begged for death; they were spared.

sentences.zh: 先後獻還八十餘人，中有被拘數十年者。

translations.literal: In succession more than eighty persons were returned, among them some who had been held for several decades.
translations.idiomatic: In all, more than eighty captives were returned, including some who had been held for decades.

sentences.zh: 臣以功紀錄優敘。

translations.literal: Chen was recorded with special commendation for his merit.
translations.idiomatic: Chen received special commendation in the merit records for this achievement.

sentences.zh: 尋進署都督同知，召僉書左府事。

translations.literal: He was soon advanced to acting regional vice commander and summoned to assist in the affairs of the Left Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to acting regional vice commander and summoned to assist in the Left Bureau of the military administration.

sentences.zh: 出為陝西總兵官，鎮守固原。

translations.literal: He went out as Shaanxi commander-in-chief and garrisoned Guyuan.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed commander-in-chief of Shaanxi and posted to Guyuan.

sentences.zh: 十八年春，移鎮甘肅。

translations.literal: In the spring of the eighteenth year he was transferred to garrison Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the eighteenth year (1590) he was transferred to command Gansu.

sentences.zh: 火落赤犯洮、河，卜失兔將往助之，其母泣沮，不從，遂攜妻女行，由永昌宋家莊穴牆入。

translations.literal: Huoluo Chi raided Tao and He; Bushitu was about to go to his aid, but his mother wept and dissuaded him; he would not listen, and so set out with his wife and daughters, entering through a breach in the wall at Song Family Hamlet in Yongchang.
translations.idiomatic: Huoluo Chi raided the Tao and He region; Bushitu prepared to join him, but his mother wept and pleaded with him in vain. He set out with his wife and daughters and entered through a breach in the wall at Song Family Hamlet in Yongchang.

sentences.zh: 臣逆戰水泉三道溝，手格殺數人，奪其坐纛。

translations.literal: Chen met them in battle at Shuiquan Sandao Gully, killed several men with his own hand in close combat, and seized their command banner.
translations.idiomatic: Chen met them at Shuiquan Sandao Gully, killed several men in hand-to-hand combat, and seized their command banner.

sentences.zh: 卜失兔及其黨炒胡兒並中流矢走，臣亦被創。

translations.literal: Bushitu and his follower Chaohu'er were both struck by arrows and fled; Chen was also wounded.
translations.idiomatic: Bushitu and his follower Chaohu'er were both wounded by arrows and fled; Chen was wounded as well.

sentences.zh: 將士斬級以百數，生獲其愛女及牛馬羊萬八百有奇。

translations.literal: The officers and soldiers beheaded enemies by the hundreds, and captured alive his beloved daughter and more than eighteen thousand head of cattle, horses, and sheep.
translations.idiomatic: His troops took hundreds of heads and captured his beloved daughter alive, along with more than eighteen thousand head of cattle, horses, and sheep.

sentences.zh: 卜失兔仰天大慟曰：「傷哉我女，悔不用母言，以至此也。」

translations.literal: Bushitu looked up to heaven and wailed greatly, saying, "Alas for my daughter! I regret not heeding my mother's words and coming to this.
translations.idiomatic: Bushitu looked up to heaven and wailed, "My poor daughter! I regret not heeding my mother's warning that brought me to this pass.

sentences.zh: 自是不敢歸巢，與宰僧匿西海。

translations.literal: From then on he did not dare return to his lair, and hid with Zaiseng in the Western Sea region.
translations.idiomatic: After that he did not dare return home and hid with Zaiseng in the Western Sea region.

sentences.zh: 已，屬宰僧謝罪，其母及順義王亦代為言，乃還其女，而使歸套。

translations.literal: Later he had Zaiseng offer an apology; his mother and the Shunyi Prince also spoke on his behalf, and his daughter was returned and he was allowed to go back to the Ordos.
translations.idiomatic: Later he sent Zaiseng to apologize; his mother and the Shunyi Prince interceded as well, and his daughter was returned and he was permitted to withdraw to the Ordos.

sentences.zh: 臣以功進秩為真。

translations.literal: Chen was advanced in rank to a regular appointment for his merit.
translations.idiomatic: For this victory Chen was promoted from acting to regular rank.

sentences.zh: 時諸部長桀驁甚，經略鄭洛專主款。

translations.literal: At the time the tribal chiefs were extremely arrogant and defiant, and the frontier commissioner Zheng Luo devoted himself solely to appeasement.
translations.idiomatic: The tribal leaders had grown increasingly defiant, while the frontier commissioner Zheng Luo insisted on appeasement alone.

sentences.zh: 臣以為不足恃，上書陳八難、五要。

translations.literal: Chen held that this could not be relied upon and submitted a memorial setting forth eight difficulties and five essentials.
translations.idiomatic: Chen argued that appeasement could not be trusted and submitted a memorial outlining eight dangers and five essentials.

sentences.zh: 大略云：邊薄兵寡，餉絀寇驕，諸部順逆難明，宜復額兵，嚴勾卒，足糧餉，分敵勢，明賞罰。

translations.literal: In summary he said: the frontier is thinly held and troops are few, supplies are short and the bandits are arrogant, the loyalty or defiance of the various tribes is hard to discern; one should restore full quotas of troops, strictly muster soldiers, provide adequate rations and pay, divide the enemy's strength, and make rewards and punishments clear.
translations.idiomatic: In brief he urged that the frontier was understaffed, supplies inadequate, and the tribes unpredictable; he called for restoring full troop quotas, strict mustering, adequate pay and provisions, dividing enemy forces, and enforcing clear rewards and punishments.

sentences.zh: 且以創重乞歸，帝不許。

translations.literal: Moreover, citing the severity of his wounds, he begged to retire, but the emperor did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked to retire on account of his wounds, but the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 後二年，謝病去。

translations.literal: Two years later he resigned on grounds of illness and left office.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later he resigned on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 臣更歷四鎮，名著塞垣，為一時良將。

translations.literal: Chen served in turn at four garrisons, his fame stood on the frontier ramparts, and he was a fine general of his age.
translations.idiomatic: Having commanded four frontier garrisons in turn, he was renowned along the border and ranked among the finest generals of his day.

sentences.zh: 子: 承廕

translations.literal: Son: Chengyin
translations.idiomatic: Son: Chengyin

sentences.zh: 子承廕，由父廕積功至延綏副總兵。

translations.literal: His son Chengyin, through his father's hereditary privilege and accumulated merit, rose to deputy commander-in-chief of Yan-sui.
translations.idiomatic: His son Chengyin, inheriting his father's privilege and accumulating merit in his own right, rose to deputy commander-in-chief of Yan-sui.

sentences.zh: 勇而有謀，尤精騎射，數鏖戰未嘗挫衂。

translations.literal: Brave and resourceful, especially skilled in mounted archery, he fought many fierce battles and never suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Brave and shrewd, an expert horse-archer, he fought many hard battles without ever suffering defeat.

sentences.zh: 萬曆三十七年代王威為延綏總兵官。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year of Wanli he replaced Wang Wei as commander-in-chief of Yan-sui.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-seventh year of Wanli (1609) he succeeded Wang Wei as commander-in-chief of Yan-sui.

sentences.zh: 沙計及猛克什力數犯邊。

translations.literal: Shaji and Mengkeshili repeatedly raided the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Shaji and Mengkeshili raided the frontier repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，復犯波羅、神木。

translations.literal: That winter they again raided Boluo and Shenmu.
translations.idiomatic: That winter they raided Boluo and Shenmu again.

sentences.zh: 承廕邀卻之，追斬八十餘人。

translations.literal: Chengyin intercepted and repelled them, pursuing and beheading more than eighty.
translations.idiomatic: Chengyin intercepted and drove them off, pursuing and killing more than eighty.

sentences.zh: 沙計欲修貢，守臣惡其反覆，拒之，益徙近邊，以數千騎犯雙山堡。

translations.literal: Shaji wished to restore tribute relations, but the frontier officials distrusted his fickleness and refused; he moved closer to the border and with several thousand horsemen raided Shuangshan Fort.
translations.idiomatic: Shaji sought to resume tribute relations, but frontier officials distrusted his volatility and refused; he moved his camps closer to the border and attacked Shuangshan Fort with several thousand horsemen.

sentences.zh: 承廕擊走之，俘斬百二十有奇。

translations.literal: Chengyin struck and drove them off, capturing and beheading more than a hundred and twenty.
translations.idiomatic: Chengyin routed them, taking more than a hundred and twenty heads and prisoners.

sentences.zh: 四十年，沙計復入塞。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year Shaji again entered the passes.
translations.idiomatic: In the fortieth year (1612) Shaji raided across the border again.

sentences.zh: 承廕遮擊之嚮水，斬首百七十餘級。

translations.literal: Chengyin intercepted and attacked them at Xiangshui, beheading more than a hundred and seventy.
translations.idiomatic: Chengyin intercepted them at Xiangshui and took more than a hundred and seventy heads.

sentences.zh: 積前功，進署都督同知，世廕本衞副千戶。

translations.literal: For his accumulated earlier merit he was advanced to acting regional vice commander, with hereditary appointment as vice chiliarch of his native guard.
translations.idiomatic: For his accumulated service he was promoted to acting regional vice commander, with a hereditary appointment as vice chiliarch of his native guard.

sentences.zh: 是歲，遼東總兵官麻貴罷，敕承廕馳代之。

translations.literal: That year the Liaodong commander-in-chief Ma Gui was dismissed, and Chengyin was ordered by edict to hurry and replace him.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Liaodong commander Ma Gui was dismissed, and Chengyin was ordered by edict to hurry north and replace him.

sentences.zh: 蟒金諸部近寧前，守將祖天壽間出獵，被圍曹莊，將士死者二百三十人，被掠者六百餘人，天壽以數騎免。

translations.literal: The Mangjin tribes were near Ningqian; the defending commander Zu Tianshou went out hunting on occasion, was surrounded at Caozhuang, two hundred and thirty officers and soldiers were killed, more than six hundred were carried off, and Tianshou escaped with a few horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: The Mangjin tribes were encamped near Ningqian; the garrison commander Zu Tianshou went out hunting and was surrounded at Caozhuang. Two hundred and thirty soldiers were killed and more than six hundred carried off; Tianshou escaped with only a few horsemen.

sentences.zh: 事聞，論死。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, he was sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: When the report reached court, he was sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 承廕初抵任，獲免。

translations.literal: When Chengyin had just arrived to take up his post, he was spared.
translations.idiomatic: Chengyin had just arrived to take command and secured his reprieve.

sentences.zh: 敖克等犯中後所，拒斬其二長，餘走出塞。

translations.literal: Aoke and others raided Zhonghousuo; Chengyin repelled them and beheaded two of their chiefs; the rest fled beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: Aoke and others raided Zhonghousuo; Chengyin repelled them, killed two of their chiefs, and drove the rest beyond the border.

sentences.zh: 時虎墩兔、炒花、煖兔、宰賽逼處遼境，無歲不犯邊。

translations.literal: At the time Huduntun, Chaohua, Nuantu, and Zaisai pressed close upon the Liaodong frontier, and not a year passed without raids.
translations.idiomatic: Huduntun, Chaohua, Nuantu, and Zaisai were pressing the Liaodong frontier, and scarcely a year passed without a raid.

sentences.zh: 承廕未至時，虎墩兔以三萬騎犯穆家堡，參將郎名忠等遏斬其四十餘騎。

translations.literal: Before Chengyin arrived, Huduntun with thirty thousand horsemen raided Mujia Fort; the assistant commander Lang Mingzhong and others intercepted them and beheaded more than forty horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: Before Chengyin arrived, Huduntun attacked Mujia Fort with thirty thousand horsemen; the assistant commander Lang Mingzhong and others intercepted them and killed more than forty.

sentences.zh: 及再舉，守將梁汝貴襲破其營。

translations.literal: When they raided again, the defending commander Liang Rugui made a surprise attack and smashed their camp.
translations.idiomatic: When they attacked again, the garrison commander Liang Rugui raided and destroyed their camp.

sentences.zh: 已而乃蠻諸部連犯中後所、連山驛，副總兵李繼功等力戰，殪其魁，徐引去。

translations.literal: Before long the Naiman tribes in succession raided Zhonghousuo and Lianshan Post; the deputy commander Li Jigong and others fought fiercely, killed their chieftain, and they slowly withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the Naiman tribes raided Zhonghousuo and Lianshan Post in succession; the deputy commander Li Jigong and others fought hard, killed their leader, and the enemy slowly withdrew.

sentences.zh: 自是虎墩兔所屬貴英哈等三十餘部悉奉約束，遼西得少安。

translations.literal: From then on more than thirty tribes under Huduntun, including Guiyingha, all submitted to discipline, and western Liaodong enjoyed a measure of peace.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter more than thirty tribes under Huduntun, including Guiyingha, submitted to Ming authority, and western Liaodong enjoyed a measure of peace.

sentences.zh: 承廕旋以病去。

translations.literal: Chengyin soon resigned on grounds of illness and left office.
translations.idiomatic: Chengyin soon resigned on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 甫歲餘，起守薊鎮。

translations.literal: Barely a year later he was recalled to garrison Jizhen.
translations.idiomatic: Barely a year later he was recalled to command Jizhen.

sentences.zh: 未至，復改鎮遼東。

translations.literal: Before he arrived he was again reassigned to command Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: Before he could take up the Jizhen post he was reassigned to Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 四十六年四月，我太祖高皇帝起兵，拔撫順，巡撫李維翰趣承廕赴援。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the forty-sixth year, Our Great Ancestor the High Emperor raised his army, captured Fushun, and the grand coordinator Li Weihan urged Chengyin to hurry to the relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the forty-sixth year (1618), the founding emperor of the Later Jin raised his army, captured Fushun, and the grand coordinator Li Weihan urged Chengyin to march to the relief.

sentences.zh: 承廕急率副將頗廷相、參將蒲世芳、遊擊梁汝貴等諸營並發，次撫順。

translations.literal: Chengyin hastily led the deputy commander Po Tingxiang, the assistant commander Pu Shifang, the mobile corps commander Liang Rugui, and the various camps to set out together, halting at Fushun.
translations.idiomatic: Chengyin hastily led the deputy commander Po Tingxiang, the assistant commander Pu Shifang, the mobile corps commander Liang Rugui, and their combined forces to Fushun.

sentences.zh: 承廕據山險，分軍三，立營浚濠，布列火器。

translations.literal: Chengyin held mountainous terrain, divided his army into three, established camps, dug moats, and arrayed firearms.
translations.idiomatic: Chengyin took up a strong position in the hills, divided his force into three camps, dug trenches, and deployed firearms.

sentences.zh: 甫交鋒，大清兵蹴之，大潰。

translations.literal: As soon as battle was joined, the Great Qing troops overran them and they collapsed in great disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Hardly had battle been joined when the Qing forces overran them and the Ming army collapsed.

sentences.zh: 承廕、世芳皆戰死。

translations.literal: Chengyin and Shifang both died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Chengyin and Pu Shifang were both killed in action.

sentences.zh: 廷相、汝貴已潰圍出，見失主將，亦陷陣死。

translations.literal: Tingxiang and Rugui had already broken out of the encirclement, but seeing that their commander was lost, they too fell in the battle line and died.
translations.idiomatic: Tingxiang and Rugui had already broken out, but on learning that their commander was dead they turned back into the fight and were killed.

sentences.zh: 將士死者萬人，生還者十無一二，舉朝震駭。

translations.literal: Officers and soldiers who died numbered ten thousand; of those who returned alive, not one in ten remained; the whole court was shaken with alarm.
translations.idiomatic: Ten thousand officers and soldiers were killed; fewer than one in ten survived. The entire court was stunned.

sentences.zh: 既而撫安、三岔兒、白家衝三堡連失，詔逮維翰，贈承廕少保、左都督，立祠曰精忠，世廕指揮僉事。

translations.literal: Before long the three forts of Fu'an, Sancha'er, and Baijiachong fell in succession; an edict ordered Li Weihan arrested; Chengyin was posthumously enfeoffed as Junior Guardian and Left Regional Commander; a shrine called Jingzhong was established; and a hereditary appointment as regional commander was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward the forts of Fu'an, Sancha'er, and Baijiachong fell in succession. Li Weihan was arrested by imperial order. Chengyin was posthumously enfeoffed as Junior Guardian and Left Regional Commander, a shrine called Jingzhong was erected in his honor, and his family received a hereditary appointment as regional commander.

sentences.zh: 廷相以下，贈廕有差。

translations.literal: Tingxiang and those below him received posthumous enfeoffments in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Tingxiang and the other fallen officers received posthumous honors of varying rank.

sentences.zh: 孫：應昌 全昌 德昌

translations.literal: Grandsons: Yingchang, Quanchang, Dechang
translations.idiomatic: Grandsons: Yingchang, Quanchang, and Dechang

sentences.zh: 承廕子應昌、全昌、德昌。

translations.literal: Chengyin's sons were Yingchang, Quanchang, and Dechang.
translations.idiomatic: Chengyin's sons were Yingchang, Quanchang, and Dechang.

sentences.zh: 應昌嗣祖臣職，當為指揮僉事。

translations.literal: Yingchang succeeded to his grandfather Chen's post and should have been regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: Yingchang inherited his grandfather Zhang Chen's hereditary post and was entitled to appointment as regional commander.

sentences.zh: 以父陣亡，增三秩為都司僉書，經略楊鎬用為左翼遊擊。

translations.literal: Because his father died in battle, he was raised three ranks to assistant secretary in the regional command and employed by the frontier commissioner Yang Hao as left-wing mobile corps commander.
translations.idiomatic: Because his father had died in battle, he was promoted three ranks to assistant secretary in the regional command and appointed by the frontier commissioner Yang Hao as left-wing mobile corps commander.

sentences.zh: 四路出師，使從李如柏。

translations.literal: When the four-route expedition set out, he was ordered to follow Li Rubai.
translations.idiomatic: When the four-route expedition was launched, he was assigned to Li Rubai's column.

sentences.zh: 天啟元年，遷大同井坪參將，調延綏。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianqi he was transferred to be assistant commander at Jingping in Datong, then reassigned to Yan-sui.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tianqi he was posted as assistant commander at Jingping in Datong, then transferred to Yan-sui.

sentences.zh: 二年秋，河套入犯，不能禦，免歸。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the second year the Ordos tribes invaded and he could not repel them; he was dismissed and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the second year the Ordos tribes raided and he failed to stop them; he was dismissed and sent home.

sentences.zh: 督師孫承宗召置麾下，命駐錦州。

translations.literal: The supreme commander Sun Chengzong summoned him to his staff and ordered him to garrison Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The supreme commander Sun Chengzong took him onto his staff and ordered him to garrison Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 承宗去，高第盡撤松、錦守具，應昌亦歸。

translations.literal: When Chengzong left, Gao Di withdrew all the defenses of Songshan and Jinzhou; Yingchang also returned.
translations.idiomatic: When Chengzong departed, Gao Di stripped the defenses of Songshan and Jinzhou; Yingchang withdrew as well.

sentences.zh: 崇禎二年，總督楊鶴檄應昌署定邊鎮將事。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chongzhen, Governor-General Yang He ordered Yingchang to act as garrison commander of Dingbian.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Chongzhen the governor-general Yang He appointed Yingchang acting commander of Dingbian.

sentences.zh: 河套入寇，擊斬百二十餘級，擢昌平副總兵，鶴遂薦應昌以副將鎮定邊。

translations.literal: When the Ordos raided, he struck and beheaded more than a hundred and twenty; he was promoted to deputy commander-in-chief at Changping, and He then recommended Yingchang as deputy general to garrison Dingbian.
translations.idiomatic: When the Ordos raided, he killed more than a hundred and twenty of the enemy and was promoted to deputy commander-in-chief at Changping; Yang He then recommended him as deputy general commanding Dingbian.

sentences.zh: 四年春，神一元陷保安，應昌偕左光先破斬一元。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year Shen Yiyuan took Bao'an; Yingchang together with Zuo Guangxian defeated and beheaded Yiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourth year Shen Yiyuan captured Bao'an; Yingchang and Zuo Guangxian defeated and killed him.

sentences.zh: 其弟一魁代領其衆，圍慶陽。

translations.literal: His younger brother Yikui took command of the band and besieged Qingyang.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Yikui took over the rebel force and besieged Qingyang.

sentences.zh: 應昌及杜文煥趨戰，圍始解。

translations.literal: Yingchang and Du Wenhuan hurried to give battle, and the siege was finally lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Yingchang and Du Wenhuan marched to relieve the city and broke the siege.

sentences.zh: 不沾泥圍米脂，應昌偕王承恩擊走之。

translations.literal: Buzhanni besieged Mizhi; Yingchang together with Wang Chengen attacked and drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: Buzhanni besieged Mizhi; Yingchang and Wang Chengen attacked and drove him off.

sentences.zh: 楊鶴撫一魁，處之寧塞，而殺其黨茹成名。

translations.literal: Yang He pacified Yikui, settled him at Ningsai, and killed his follower Ru Chengming.
translations.idiomatic: Yang He pacified Yikui, resettled him at Ningsai, and executed his follower Ru Chengming.

sentences.zh: 賊黨張孟金、黃友才懼，挾一魁以叛。

translations.literal: The bandit followers Zhang Mengjin and Huang Youcai grew afraid and seized Yikui to rebel.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel followers Zhang Mengjin and Huang Youcai, fearing for themselves, seized Yikui and rebelled again.

sentences.zh: 延綏巡撫張福臻令應昌及馬科擊之，斬首千七百餘級。

translations.literal: The Yan-sui grand coordinator Zhang Fuzhen ordered Yingchang and Ma Ke to attack them, and more than seventeen hundred heads were taken.
translations.idiomatic: The Yan-sui grand coordinator Zhang Fuzhen ordered Yingchang and Ma Ke to attack them; they took more than seventeen hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 友才走，一魁守不下。

translations.literal: Youcai fled, but Yikui held out and could not be taken.
translations.idiomatic: Youcai fled, but Yikui held his position and could not be dislodged.

sentences.zh: 其冬，洪承疇代鶴，命參政戴君恩、總兵曹文詔同應昌討之。

translations.literal: That winter Hong Chengchou replaced He and ordered the administration commissioner Dai Jun'en and the commander Cao Wenchao to join Yingchang in suppressing them.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Hong Chengchou replaced Yang He and ordered the administration commissioner Dai Jun'en and the commander Cao Wenchao to join Yingchang in the campaign.

sentences.zh: 數敗賊，賊棄城走。

translations.literal: They defeated the bandits several times, and the bandits abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: After several defeats the rebels abandoned the city and fled.

sentences.zh: 文詔偕應昌擊敗之駙馬溝。

translations.literal: Wenchao together with Yingchang defeated them at Zhumagou.
translations.idiomatic: Wenchao and Yingchang defeated them again at Zhumagou.

sentences.zh: 明年春，應昌禽友才。

translations.literal: The following spring Yingchang captured Youcai.
translations.idiomatic: The following spring Yingchang captured Huang Youcai.

sentences.zh: 混天猴陷宜君、鄜州，襲靖邊，應昌追敗之，射傷賊將白廣恩。

translations.literal: Huntianhou took Yijun and Fuzhou, raided Jingbian; Yingchang pursued and defeated him, wounding the bandit general Bai Guang'en with an arrow.
translations.idiomatic: Huntianhou captured Yijun and Fuzhou and raided Jingbian; Yingchang pursued, defeated him, and wounded the rebel general Bai Guang'en with an arrow.

sentences.zh: 八月，山西總兵官馬士麟病免，擢應昌都督僉事代之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the Shanxi commander Ma Shilin was dismissed on grounds of illness, and Yingchang was promoted to regional commander to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Shanxi commander Ma Shilin resigned on grounds of illness, and Yingchang was promoted to regional commander to replace him.

sentences.zh: 言者謂寧武卒善逃，宜令應昌率所部三千人以從，報可。

translations.literal: Memorialists said the Ningwu troops were skilled at desertion and that Yingchang should be ordered to lead his three thousand men to follow; the request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Critics noted that the Ningwu troops were prone to desertion and urged that Yingchang lead his three thousand men personally; the court approved.

sentences.zh: 王之臣陷臨縣。

translations.literal: Wang Zhichen took Linxian.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhichen captured Linxian.

sentences.zh: 其地倚黃雲山，榆林河水出焉，入於黃河。

translations.literal: The place leaned on Yellow Cloud Mountain; the Yulin River issues there and enters the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: The town stood against Yellow Cloud Mountain; the Yulin River rises there and flows into the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 城三面峭壁，西阻水。

translations.literal: The city had sheer cliffs on three sides and was blocked by water on the west.
translations.idiomatic: The city was protected by sheer cliffs on three sides and by the river on the west.

sentences.zh: 巡撫許鼎臣、總督張宗衡督兵攻。

translations.literal: The grand coordinator Xu Dingchen and the governor-general Zhang Zongheng supervised troops in the attack.
translations.idiomatic: The grand coordinator Xu Dingchen and the governor-general Zhang Zongheng directed the siege.

sentences.zh: 賊與土寇田福、田科等相倚，久不拔。

translations.literal: The bandits relied on local raiders Tian Fu, Tian Ke, and others; for a long time the city could not be taken.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels were supported by local bandits Tian Fu, Tian Ke, and others, and the city held out for a long time.

sentences.zh: 會王自用陷遼州，逼會城。

translations.literal: As it happened Wang Ziyong took Liaozhou and pressed upon Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Wang Ziyong captured Liaozhou and threatened Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 鼎臣還，專以恢復責應昌。

translations.literal: Dingchen returned, placing the entire responsibility for recovery on Yingchang alone.
translations.idiomatic: Dingchen withdrew, leaving Yingchang solely responsible for retaking Linxian.

sentences.zh: 六年春，賊約福劫官軍，撫標中軍陳國威因偽稱之臣往逆，斬福頭懸城下，急擊，賊始降。

translations.literal: In the spring of the sixth year the bandits plotted with Fu to ambush the government troops; the pacification command's central corps commander Chen Guowei pretended to be Zhichen going to meet them, beheaded Fu and hung his head below the wall, pressed the attack fiercely, and only then did the bandits surrender.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the sixth year the rebels plotted with Tian Fu to ambush government troops. Chen Guowei of the pacification command pretended to be Wang Zhichen going out to parley, beheaded Fu, and displayed his head beneath the walls; a fierce assault followed and the rebels finally surrendered.

sentences.zh: 應昌在關中，威名甚著。

translations.literal: Yingchang in Guanzhong had a very great reputation.
translations.idiomatic: In Guanzhong Yingchang had enjoyed a formidable reputation.

sentences.zh: 及是選懦逗撓，務與賊相避。

translations.literal: But now he was timid and procrastinating, striving above all to avoid the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Now, however, he grew timid and evasive, taking care above all to avoid engaging the rebels.

sentences.zh: 總督宗衡五檄之不赴，奏諸朝，限應昌與文詔三月平賊。

translations.literal: Governor-General Zongheng summoned him five times by urgent dispatch and he did not come; he memorialized the court and set a limit of three months for Yingchang and Wenchao to pacify the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Zongheng summoned him five times without response and memorialized the throne, giving Yingchang and Wenchao three months to crush the rebels.

sentences.zh: 應昌避賊不擊，殺良民冒功，為巡按御史李嵩、兵科祝世美所劾。

translations.literal: Yingchang avoided the bandits and would not attack, killed innocent people to claim merit, and was impeached by the touring censor Li Song and the military affairs secretary Zhu Shimei.
translations.idiomatic: Yingchang shunned battle, killed civilians to claim credit, and was impeached by the touring censor Li Song and the military affairs secretary Zhu Shimei.

sentences.zh: 帝乃遣近侍為應昌內中軍。

translations.literal: The emperor then sent a palace attendant to serve as Yingchang's inner staff commander.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then sent a palace attendant to serve as Yingchang's internal staff commander to supervise him.

sentences.zh: 七月，部卒潰鳴謙驛。

translations.literal: In the seventh month his troops mutinied at Mingqian Post.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month his troops mutinied at Mingqian Post.

sentences.zh: 監視中官劉允中劾其避賊，帝猶貸之，令會勦畿南賊。

translations.literal: The supervising eunuch Liu Yunzhong impeached him for avoiding the bandits; the emperor still spared him and ordered him to join in suppressing the bandits south of the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: The supervising eunuch Liu Yunzhong impeached him for shunning battle, but the emperor spared him and ordered him to join the campaign against rebels south of the capital.

sentences.zh: 久之，擊賊平山，偽報首功，連為允中及巡按御史馮明玠、真定巡撫周堪賡所劾，帝令圖功自贖。

translations.literal: After a long while he attacked bandits at Pingshan and falsely reported the highest merit; he was impeached in succession by Yunzhong, the touring censor Feng Mingjie, and the Zhending grand coordinator Zhou Kangeng; the emperor ordered him to redeem himself by achieving merit.
translations.idiomatic: Later he fought rebels at Pingshan and falsely claimed the highest credit; Liu Yunzhong, the touring censor Feng Mingjie, and the Zhending grand coordinator Zhou Kangeng impeached him in turn, and the emperor ordered him to redeem himself through further service.

sentences.zh: 七年春，追賊靈寶，稍有功。

translations.literal: In the spring of the seventh year he pursued bandits to Lingbao and achieved some merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the seventh year he pursued rebels to Lingbao and won some minor victories.

sentences.zh: 已，擊賊均州五嶺山，敗績。

translations.literal: Later he attacked bandits at Wuling Mountain in Junzhou and suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Later he attacked rebels at Wuling Mountain in Junzhou and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 身中一矢，退還河南。

translations.literal: He was struck by one arrow in the body and withdrew to Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Wounded by an arrow, he withdrew to Henan.

sentences.zh: 其弟全昌為宣府總兵官。

translations.literal: His younger brother Quanchang was commander-in-chief of Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Quanchang was commander-in-chief of Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 宣府有警，令應昌援，又無功，令解職候勘。

translations.literal: When Xuanfu had an alarm, Yingchang was ordered to reinforce; again he achieved nothing, and was ordered to resign his post pending investigation.
translations.idiomatic: When Xuanfu came under attack, Yingchang was ordered to reinforce but achieved nothing; he was relieved of command pending investigation.

sentences.zh: 八年，洪承疇出師河南，令率私家士馬以從。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Hong Chengchou marched into Henan and ordered him to lead his private troops and horses to follow.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Hong Chengchou marched into Henan and ordered Yingchang to bring his private troops and horses.

sentences.zh: 三月抵信陽。

translations.literal: In the third month he reached Xinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month he reached Xinyang.

sentences.zh: 會賊大入秦，承疇命應昌及鄧玘、尤翟文防漢江南北。

translations.literal: As it happened the bandits made a major incursion into Shaanxi; Chengchou ordered Yingchang, Deng Qi, and You Zhaiwen to defend north and south of the Han River.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels meanwhile poured into Shaanxi; Chengchou ordered Yingchang, Deng Qi, and You Zhaiwen to guard both banks of the Han River.

sentences.zh: 玘死，承疇以賊必由鳳縣棧道直入略陽，改令應昌、翟文自鄖陽轉赴興安、漢中，以會左光先、趙光遠諸軍。

translations.literal: Qi died; Chengchou judged that the bandits would surely take the plank road from Feng County straight into Lueyang, and changed the order so that Yingchang and Zhaiwen should turn from Yunyang toward Xing'an and Hanzhong to join the armies of Zuo Guangxian, Zhao Guangyuan, and others.
translations.idiomatic: After Qi was killed, Chengchou judged that the rebels would take the Feng County plank road into Lueyang and redirected Yingchang and Zhaiwen from Yunyang toward Xing'an and Hanzhong to join Zuo Guangxian, Zhao Guangyuan, and the other columns.

sentences.zh: 至六月，艾萬年、曹文詔相繼戰歿，賊盡趨西安，承疇急檄應昌及光先還救。

translations.literal: By the sixth month Ai Wannian and Cao Wenchao died in battle in succession, the bandits all pressed toward Xi'an, and Chengchou urgently dispatched Yingchang and Guangxian to return to the rescue.
translations.idiomatic: By the sixth month Ai Wannian and Cao Wenchao had been killed in action and the rebels were converging on Xi'an; Chengchou urgently recalled Yingchang and Guangxian.

sentences.zh: 八月，李自成陷咸陽。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Li Zicheng took Xianyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Li Zicheng captured Xianyang.

sentences.zh: 越二日，應昌、光先兵至，擊斬四百四十餘級，獲軍師一人。

translations.literal: Two days later the troops of Yingchang and Guangxian arrived, struck and beheaded more than four hundred and forty, and captured one military adviser.
translations.idiomatic: Two days later Yingchang and Guangxian arrived, killed more than four hundred and forty rebels, and captured a military adviser.

sentences.zh: 及全昌兵敗陷賊，其潰卒歸關中，掠沿河州縣。

translations.literal: When Quanchang's army was defeated and he fell into the bandits' hands, his routed soldiers returned to Guanzhong and plundered the counties along the river.
translations.idiomatic: When Quanchang was defeated and captured, his routed troops returned to Guanzhong and plundered counties along the river.

sentences.zh: 山西巡撫吳甡請令應昌收置麾下，應昌已得疾，不能軍。

translations.literal: The Shanxi grand coordinator Wu Shen requested that Yingchang take them into his command; Yingchang had already fallen ill and could not take the field.
translations.idiomatic: The Shanxi grand coordinator Wu Shen asked that Yingchang take them into his command, but Yingchang had fallen ill and could no longer take the field.

sentences.zh: 無何卒。

translations.literal: Before long he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon afterward.

sentences.zh: 全昌由廕敘，歷官靈州參將。

translations.literal: Quanchang entered office through hereditary privilege and served as assistant commander at Lingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Quanchang entered service through hereditary privilege and rose to assistant commander at Lingzhou.

sentences.zh: 崇禎四年與同官趙大胤擊點燈子於中部，已，連戰郃陽、韓城，首功多。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Chongzhen he and his colleague Zhao Dayin attacked Diandengzi at Zhongbu; afterward they fought repeatedly at Heyang and Hancheng, taking the most heads.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Chongzhen he and his colleague Zhao Dayin fought Diandengzi at Zhongbu, then won repeated engagements at Heyang and Hancheng, taking the lion's share of the credit.

sentences.zh: 巡撫練國事請加二將副將銜。

translations.literal: The grand coordinator Lian Guoshi requested that the two generals be given the title of deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: The grand coordinator Lian Guoshi requested deputy-commander titles for both generals.

sentences.zh: 大胤駐耀州、富平間，扼賊西路；

translations.literal: Dayin garrisoned between Yaozhou and Fuping, blocking the bandits' western route;
translations.idiomatic: Dayin garrisoned between Yaozhou and Fuping to block the rebels' western route;

sentences.zh: 全昌駐韓城、郃陽間，扼賊東路。

translations.literal: Quanchang garrisoned between Hancheng and Heyang, blocking the bandits' eastern route.
translations.idiomatic: Quanchang garrisoned between Hancheng and Heyang to block their eastern route.

sentences.zh: 五年七月，代應昌為定邊副總兵。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fifth year he replaced Yingchang as deputy commander-in-chief of Dingbian.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fifth year he succeeded Yingchang as deputy commander-in-chief of Dingbian.

sentences.zh: 曹文詔追賊隴州、平、鳳界，全昌及馬科率千人應之，殄滅殆盡。

translations.literal: Cao Wenchao pursued bandits on the borders of Longzhou, Pingliang, and Fengxiang; Quanchang and Ma Ke led a thousand men to support him, and the bandits were nearly exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Wenchao pursued rebels through Longzhou and the Pingliang-Fengxiang region; Quanchang and Ma Ke brought a thousand men to his aid and nearly wiped them out.

sentences.zh: 明年五月擢署都督僉事，充總兵官，鎮守宣府。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the following year he was promoted to acting regional commander and appointed commander-in-chief, garrisoning Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: The following May he was promoted to acting regional commander and appointed commander-in-chief of Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 應昌方鎮山西，兄弟接壤為大帥。

translations.literal: Yingchang was then commanding Shanxi; the brothers held adjoining commands as great generals.
translations.idiomatic: Yingchang was then commanding Shanxi; the two brothers held adjoining commands as the region's foremost generals.

sentences.zh: 明年七月，大清兵西征插漢，旋師入其境。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the following year the Great Qing troops campaigned west against Chakhar and, on their return march, entered his territory.
translations.idiomatic: The following July the Qing army marched west against Chakhar and, on the return march, entered Xuanfu territory.

sentences.zh: 攻圍龍門、新城、赤城、克保安州，薄鎮城，全昌嬰城固守。

translations.literal: They attacked and besieged Longmen, Xincheng, and Chicheng, captured Bao'an Prefecture, pressed close to the garrison city, and Quanchang held the city and defended stubbornly.
translations.idiomatic: They besieged Longmen, Xincheng, and Chicheng, captured Bao'an Prefecture, and pressed the garrison city; Quanchang held firm behind the walls.

sentences.zh: 已而大清兵西行，全昌進兵應州。

translations.literal: Before long the Great Qing troops marched west; Quanchang advanced his army to Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When the Qing forces marched west, Quanchang advanced to Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 帝以其孤軍，敕吳襄、尤世威赴援，不應。

translations.literal: The emperor, because his army was isolated, ordered Wu Xiang and You Shiwei to hurry to his relief; they did not respond.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing that his force was isolated, the emperor ordered Wu Xiang and You Shiwei to reinforce him; they did not come.

sentences.zh: 全昌至渾源，以捷聞，還軍葛峪、羊房口。

translations.literal: Quanchang reached Hunyuan, reported a victory, and returned his army to Geyu and Yangfangkou.
translations.idiomatic: Quanchang reached Hunyuan, reported a victory, and withdrew to Geyu and Yangfangkou.

sentences.zh: 襄等復不援。

translations.literal: Xiang and the others again did not reinforce him.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Xiang and the others again failed to reinforce him.

sentences.zh: 八月，大清兵再入其境。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the Great Qing troops again entered his territory.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Qing army invaded again.

sentences.zh: 閏八月四日克萬全右衞，他城堡多失守。

translations.literal: On the fourth day of the intercalary eighth month they captured Wanquan Right Guard, and many other forts and castles were lost.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourth day of the intercalary eighth month they captured Wanquan Right Guard, and many other forts fell.

sentences.zh: 既解嚴，兄應昌以罪解職，命全昌并將其軍。

translations.literal: After the emergency was lifted, his elder brother Yingchang was dismissed for his crimes, and Quanchang was ordered to command his army as well.
translations.idiomatic: After the emergency ended, his brother Yingchang was dismissed for misconduct, and Quanchang was ordered to take over his troops as well.

sentences.zh: 兵科常自裕言文臣張宗衡等重論，而武臣輕貸，非法。

translations.literal: The military affairs secretary Chang Ziyu said that civil officials such as Zhang Zongheng received heavy punishment while military officials were lightly spared, which was contrary to law.
translations.idiomatic: The military affairs secretary Chang Ziyu protested that civil officials such as Zhang Zongheng were punished severely while military commanders were let off lightly, contrary to proper practice.

sentences.zh: 於是全昌與文詔並戍邊。

translations.literal: Thereupon Quanchang and Wenchao were both banished to garrison the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Quanchang and Wenchao were both banished to frontier garrison duty.

sentences.zh: 用山西巡撫吳甡請，命全昌、文詔為援勦總兵官，與猛如虎等大破高加計。

translations.literal: At the request of the Shanxi grand coordinator Wu Shen, Quanchang and Wenchao were appointed relief-suppression commanders-in-chief and, together with Meng Ruhu and others, inflicted a great defeat on Gao Jiaji.
translations.idiomatic: At the request of the Shanxi grand coordinator Wu Shen, Quanchang and Wenchao were appointed relief commanders and, with Meng Ruhu and others, inflicted a major defeat on Gao Jiaji.

sentences.zh: 八年春，會洪承疇於汝寧，擊敗汝州賊。

translations.literal: In the spring of the eighth year he joined Hong Chengchou at Runing and defeated the bandits of Ruzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the eighth year he joined Hong Chengchou at Runing and defeated the Ruzhou rebels.

sentences.zh: 俄西入關，與祖大弼敗賊涇陽。

translations.literal: Soon he entered the passes to the west and, together with Zu Dabian, defeated bandits at Jingyang.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he entered the passes and, with Zu Dabian, defeated rebels at Jingyang.

sentences.zh: 未幾，敗賊醴泉。

translations.literal: Before long he defeated bandits at Liquan.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward he defeated rebels at Liquan.

sentences.zh: 五月與賀人龍敗老回回於秦王嶺。

translations.literal: In the fifth month he and He Renlong defeated Lao Huihui at Qinwang Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he and He Renlong defeated Lao Huihui at Qinwang Ridge.

sentences.zh: 尋解鳳翔圍，走賊秦州，敗之張家川。

translations.literal: Soon he lifted the siege of Fengxiang, drove the bandits toward Qinzhou, and defeated them at Zhangjiachuan.
translations.idiomatic: He soon lifted the siege of Fengxiang, drove the rebels toward Qinzhou, and defeated them at Zhangjiachuan.

sentences.zh: 已而都司田應龍、張應龍戰死，艾萬年、曹文詔相繼歿，官軍益衰，賊盡趨西安。

translations.literal: Before long the regional commanders Tian Yinglong and Zhang Yinglong died in battle, Ai Wannian and Cao Wenchao died in succession, the government troops grew ever weaker, and the bandits all pressed toward Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the regional commanders Tian Yinglong and Zhang Yinglong were killed, Ai Wannian and Cao Wenchao died in succession, government forces weakened further, and the rebels converged on Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 承疇急檄全昌及曹變蛟先赴渭、華格其前，親督軍尾其後，却賊紅鄉溝，賊乃南入商、雒。

translations.literal: Chengchou urgently dispatched Quanchang and Cao Bianjiao to hurry first to Wei and Hua to block them in front, personally supervised the army following behind, repelled the bandits at Hongxiang Gully, and the bandits then entered Shang and Luo to the south.
translations.idiomatic: Chengchou urgently ordered Quanchang and Cao Bianjiao to block the rebels at Wei and Hua, led the main force in pursuit, drove them back at Hongxiang Gully, and forced them south into Shang and Luo.

sentences.zh: 承疇又命全昌及趙光遠提兵三千截潼關大峪口，部卒大譁，闌入滎澤，劫庫殺人。

translations.literal: Chengchou again ordered Quanchang and Zhao Guangyuan to lead three thousand troops to intercept at Dayukou on Tong Pass; the troops mutinied loudly, broke into Xingze, plundered the treasury, and killed people.
translations.idiomatic: Chengchou then ordered Quanchang and Zhao Guangyuan to block Dayukou on Tong Pass with three thousand men; the troops mutinied, stormed into Xingze, looted the treasury, and killed civilians.

sentences.zh: 河南巡撫玄默請急援盧氏，不聽。

translations.literal: The Henan grand coordinator Xuan Mo requested urgent relief for Lushi; he did not listen.
translations.idiomatic: The Henan grand coordinator Xuan Mo pleaded for urgent relief at Lushi; Quanchang ignored him.

sentences.zh: 光遠擅歸關中，全昌迤邐至潁州。

translations.literal: Guangyuan returned to Guanzhong on his own authority; Quanchang slowly made his way to Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Guangyuan withdrew to Guanzhong without orders; Quanchang drifted slowly toward Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月中，追蝎子塊於沈邱瓦店，戰敗被執，賊挾之攻蘄、黃。

translations.literal: In the ninth month he pursued Xiezikuai to Wadian in Shenqiu, was defeated and captured; the bandits seized him to attack Qi and Huang.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he pursued Xiezikuai to Wadian in Shenqiu, was defeated and captured, and the rebels used him to attack Qi and Huang prefectures.

sentences.zh: 全昌因代賊求撫，總理盧象昇不許，責全昌喪師辱國，曰「賊果欲降，可滅其黨示信」。

translations.literal: Quanchang therefore pleaded with the bandits for pacification on their behalf; the supreme commander Lu Xiangsheng did not permit it, rebuked Quanchang for losing his army and disgracing the state, and said, "If the bandits truly wish to surrender, let them destroy their followers to show good faith."
translations.idiomatic: Quanchang then negotiated surrender on the rebels' behalf; the supreme commander Lu Xiangsheng refused, rebuked him for losing his army and disgracing the state, and said, "If they truly wish to surrender, let them destroy their own followers first as proof of good faith."

sentences.zh: 賊不聽命。

translations.literal: The bandits did not obey.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels refused.

sentences.zh: 久之，全昌脫歸，謁象昇陽和。

translations.literal: After a long while Quanchang escaped and returned, and visited Xiangsheng at Yanghe.
translations.idiomatic: After a long captivity Quanchang escaped and presented himself to Xiangsheng at Yanghe.

sentences.zh: 象昇令募兵山、陝。

translations.literal: Xiangsheng ordered him to recruit troops in Shanxi and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangsheng ordered him to raise troops in Shanxi and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 尋薦之朝，令赴軍前立功，帝不許。

translations.literal: Soon he recommended him to the court and ordered him to go to the front to achieve merit; the emperor did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: He soon recommended Quanchang to the court and asked that he be sent to the front to redeem himself; the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 十年四月，以楊嗣昌言逮付法司，謫戍邊衞。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the tenth year, on Yang Sichang's word he was arrested and handed to the judiciary, and banished to garrison a frontier guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the tenth year, on Yang Sichang's recommendation he was arrested, tried, and banished to frontier garrison duty.

sentences.zh: 德昌，崇禎初為清水營守備。

translations.literal: Dechang, at the beginning of Chongzhen, was garrison commander of Qingshui Camp.
translations.idiomatic: Dechang served as garrison commander of Qingshui Camp early in the Chongzhen reign.

sentences.zh: 三年夏，勦王嘉胤被傷，坐奪官。

translations.literal: In the summer of the third year, while suppressing Wang Jiayin he was wounded and was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the third year he was wounded while suppressing Wang Jiayin and was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 久之，起歷保定參將，連破土寇仁義王。

translations.literal: After a long while he was recalled and served as assistant commander at Baoding, repeatedly defeating the local bandit Renyiwang.
translations.idiomatic: After a long interval he was recalled and posted as assistant commander at Baoding, where he repeatedly defeated the local bandit known as Renyiwang.

sentences.zh: 十四年春，總督楊文岳命從虎大威以五千人援開封，不敢進。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourteenth year Governor-General Yang Wenyue ordered him to follow Hu Dawei with five thousand men to relieve Kaifeng; he did not dare advance.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourteenth year Governor-General Yang Wenyue ordered him to follow Hu Dawei with five thousand men to relieve Kaifeng, but he did not dare advance.

sentences.zh: 其冬，擢保定副總兵，仍從文岳，數有功。

translations.literal: That winter he was promoted to deputy commander-in-chief at Baoding, still following Wenyue, and achieved merit on several occasions.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he was promoted to deputy commander-in-chief at Baoding and continued under Wenyue, winning credit in several engagements.

sentences.zh: 十六年卒。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the sixteenth year.

sentences.zh: 贈特進榮祿大夫，左都督。

translations.literal: He was posthumously enfeoffed as Special Advancement Grand Master of Splendid Blessings and Left Regional Commander.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously enfeoffed as Special Advancement Grand Master of Splendid Blessings and Left Regional Commander.

sentences.zh: 董一元

translations.literal: Dong Yiyuan
translations.idiomatic: Dong Yiyuan

sentences.zh: 董一元，宣府前衞人。

translations.literal: Dong Yiyuan was a man of Xuanfu Front Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Yiyuan was a native of Xuanfu Front Guard.

sentences.zh: 父暘，嘉靖中為宣府遊擊將軍。

translations.literal: His father Yang, in the Jiajing reign, was mobile corps commander of Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: His father Yang served as mobile corps commander of Xuanfu under the Jiajing emperor.

sentences.zh: 俺答犯滴水崖，力戰死。

translations.literal: When Altan raided Dishui Cliff, he fought fiercely and died.
translations.idiomatic: When Altan raided Dishui Cliff, he fought to the death.

sentences.zh: 贈官錫廕，春秋世祀。

translations.literal: An office was posthumously granted, hereditary privilege bestowed, and he received seasonal sacrifices in perpetuity.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously honored with an office and hereditary privilege, and received seasonal sacrifices in perpetuity.

sentences.zh: 兄一奎，都督僉事。

translations.literal: His elder brother Yikui was regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: His elder brother Yikui rose to regional commander.

sentences.zh: 歷鎮山西、延綏、寧夏三邊，以勇敢著。

translations.literal: He commanded in turn the three frontiers of Shanxi, Yan-sui, and Ningxia, and was noted for his bravery.
translations.idiomatic: He commanded in turn the Shanxi, Yan-sui, and Ningxia frontiers and was renowned for his courage.

sentences.zh: 一元勇如兄，而智略過之。

translations.literal: Yiyuan was as brave as his brother, but surpassed him in resourcefulness and strategy.
translations.idiomatic: Yiyuan matched his brother in courage but surpassed him in strategy.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖時，歷薊鎮遊擊將軍。

translations.literal: In the Jiajing reign he served as mobile corps commander of Jizhen.
translations.idiomatic: Under Jiajing he served as mobile corps commander of Jizhen.

sentences.zh: 土蠻、黑石炭等以萬餘騎犯一片石，總兵官胡鎮禦之，一元功最，超俸三級，遷石門寨參將。

translations.literal: Tumen, Heishitan, and others with more than ten thousand horsemen raided Yipianshi; the commander-in-chief Hu Zhen repelled them; Yiyuan's merit was greatest; he was advanced three salary grades beyond the norm and transferred to be assistant commander at Shimen Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Tumen, Heishitan, and others attacked Yipianshi with more than ten thousand horsemen; the commander Hu Zhen repelled them, but Yiyuan won the greatest credit, was advanced three salary grades, and was appointed assistant commander at Shimen Stockade.

sentences.zh: 隆慶初，破敵棒槌崖，功復最。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Longqing he defeated the enemy at Bangchui Cliff, and again his merit was greatest.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Longqing he defeated the enemy at Bangchui Cliff and again won top credit.

sentences.zh: 再進二級，遷副總兵，駐防古北口。

translations.literal: He was advanced two more ranks, transferred to deputy commander-in-chief, and garrisoned Gubeikou.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted two more ranks, appointed deputy commander-in-chief, and posted to Gubeikou.

sentences.zh: 移守宣府。

translations.literal: He was moved to defend Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to command Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 萬曆十一年以都督僉事為昌平總兵官，尋徙宣府。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Wanli he was made commander-in-chief of Changping as regional commander, and soon was transferred to Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Wanli he was appointed commander-in-chief of Changping as regional commander, then transferred to Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 十五年徙薊州。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was transferred to Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was transferred to Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 久之，劾罷。

translations.literal: After a long while he was impeached and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Eventually he was impeached and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 鄭洛經略洮、河，命一元練兵西寧。

translations.literal: Zheng Luo was frontier commissioner of Tao and He and ordered Yiyuan to drill troops at Xining.
translations.idiomatic: When Zheng Luo became frontier commissioner of the Tao and He region, he ordered Yiyuan to train troops at Xining.

sentences.zh: 火落赤入犯，一元擊之西川，多所斬獲。

translations.literal: When Huoluo Chi invaded, Yiyuan attacked him in Xichuan and took many heads and captives.
translations.idiomatic: When Huoluo Chi invaded, Yiyuan attacked him in Xichuan and took many heads and captives.

sentences.zh: 尋以副總兵協守寧夏，擢延綏總兵官。

translations.literal: Soon he was made deputy commander-in-chief to assist in defending Ningxia, then promoted to commander-in-chief of Yan-sui.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed deputy commander to assist at Ningxia, then promoted to commander-in-chief of Yan-sui.

sentences.zh: 哱拜之亂，套中諸部長悉助之。

translations.literal: In the rebellion of Pobei, all the tribal chiefs of the Ordos aided him.
translations.idiomatic: During the rebellion of Pobei, all the Ordos tribal chiefs supported him.

sentences.zh: 一元乘其西掠，輕騎搗土昧巢，獲首功百三十，驅其畜產而還，寇內顧引去。

translations.literal: Yiyuan took advantage of their western raid, led light cavalry to strike Tumai's lair, took a hundred and thirty heads, drove off their livestock and returned, and the bandits, looking to their rear, withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Yiyuan exploited their western raid to strike Tumai's lair with light cavalry, took a hundred and thirty heads, drove off their herds, and forced the raiders to withdraw to protect their rear.

sentences.zh: 進署都督同知，入為中府僉事。

translations.literal: He was advanced to acting regional vice commander and entered the capital as an assistant in the Central Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to acting regional vice commander and appointed an assistant in the Central Bureau at court.

sentences.zh: 遼東自李成梁後，代以楊紹勳，一歲三失事。

translations.literal: In Liaodong, after Li Chengliang, Yang Shaoxun replaced him and in one year three disasters occurred.
translations.idiomatic: After Li Chengliang left Liaodong, Yang Shaoxun succeeded him and presided over three major disasters in a single year.

sentences.zh: 尤繼先繼之，半歲病去。

translations.literal: You Jixian succeeded him and left on grounds of illness after half a year.
translations.idiomatic: You Jixian succeeded him but resigned on grounds of illness after half a year.

sentences.zh: 廷議擇帥，乃以命一元。

translations.literal: The court deliberated on choosing a commander, and the appointment was given to Yiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: The court deliberated on a new commander and appointed Yiyuan.

sentences.zh: 泰寧速把亥為官軍所殺，其次子把兔兒常欲復讐。

translations.literal: Subahai of Taining was killed by government troops; his second son Batuer constantly sought revenge.
translations.idiomatic: Subahai of Taining had been killed by government troops; his second son Batuer had long sought revenge.

sentences.zh: 從父炒花及姑壻花大助之，勢益強。

translations.literal: His father's younger brother Chaohua and his sister's husband Huada aided him, and their power grew ever stronger.
translations.idiomatic: His uncle Chaohua and his brother-in-law Huada supported him, and their power grew.

sentences.zh: 西部卜言台周，故插漢土蠻子也，部衆十餘萬，與把兔兒東西相倚，數侵邊。

translations.literal: Buyan Taiju of the western tribes, formerly Tumen's son of Chakhar, had a following of more than a hundred thousand; he and Batuer supported each other east and west and repeatedly raided the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Buyan Taiju of the western tribes, a descendant of Chakhar Tumen, commanded more than a hundred thousand followers; he and Batuer supported each other from east and west and raided the frontier repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 至是卜言合一克灰正、腦毛大諸部，聲犯廣寧。

translations.literal: At this time Buyan united the tribes of Yikehuizheng, Naomao Da, and others, and announced an attack on Guangning.
translations.idiomatic: Buyan now united the tribes of Yikehuizheng, Naomao Da, and others and threatened Guangning.

sentences.zh: 而把兔兒以炒花、花大、煖兔、伯言兒之衆營舊遼陽，將入掠鎮武、錦、義。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Batuer with the forces of Chaohua, Huada, Nuantu, and Boyan'er encamped at old Liaoyang and was about to raid Zhenwu, Jin, and Yi.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Batuer camped at old Liaoyang with the forces of Chaohua, Huada, Nuantu, and Boyan'er and prepared to raid Zhenwu, Jin, and Yi.

sentences.zh: 一元與巡撫李化龍策曰：「卜言雖衆，然去邊遠，我特患把兔兒及炒花耳。

translations.literal: Yiyuan and the grand coordinator Li Hualong planned together, saying, "Although Buyan's force is large, it is far from the border; what we truly fear is Batuer and Chaohua.
translations.idiomatic: Yiyuan and the grand coordinator Li Hualong agreed: "Buyan's force is large but far from the border; our real concern is Batuer and Chaohua.

sentences.zh: 今其衆不過萬騎，破之則西部將不戰走。」

translations.literal: Their force now is no more than ten thousand horsemen; if we defeat them, the western tribes will flee without fighting.
translations.idiomatic: They have no more than ten thousand horsemen; defeat them and the western tribes will flee without a fight.

sentences.zh: 乃遣副將孫守廉馳右屯禦西部，而親將大軍匿鎮武外，為空營待之。

translations.literal: He therefore sent the deputy commander Sun Shoulian to hurry to You Tun to repel the western tribes, while he personally led the main army to hide outside Zhenwu and set up an empty camp to await them.
translations.idiomatic: He sent the deputy commander Sun Shoulian to You Tun to hold off the western tribes, while he personally hid the main army outside Zhenwu and set an empty camp as bait.

sentences.zh: 寇騎馳入營，大笑，以為怯，乃深入。

translations.literal: The bandit horsemen galloped into the camp, laughed loudly, thought the troops were cowardly, and pressed deep inside.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy horsemen galloped into the camp, laughed at what they took for cowardice, and pressed deep inside.

sentences.zh: 官軍忽從中起，奮呼陷陣，自午至酉。

translations.literal: The government troops suddenly rose from within, shouted fiercely, and charged into the battle line from noon until dusk.
translations.idiomatic: Government troops suddenly rose from ambush, shouting as they charged, and fought from noon until dusk.

sentences.zh: 寇大奔，逐北七十餘里，至白沙堝。

translations.literal: The bandits fled in great disorder; they were pursued north more than seventy li to Baisha'ao.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy fled in disorder and were pursued more than seventy li to Baisha'ao.

sentences.zh: 俘斬五百四十有奇，獲馬駝二千計。

translations.literal: More than five hundred and forty were captured or beheaded, and about two thousand horses and camels were taken.
translations.idiomatic: More than five hundred and forty were killed or captured, and about two thousand horses and camels were seized.

sentences.zh: 伯言兒中矢死，把兔兒亦傷，餘衆終夜馳，天明駐馬環哭。

translations.literal: Boyan'er was struck by an arrow and died; Batuer was also wounded; the remainder galloped all night, and at dawn they halted their horses and wept in a circle.
translations.idiomatic: Boyan'er was killed by an arrow; Batuer was wounded; the survivors rode through the night and at dawn halted their horses and wept in a circle.

sentences.zh: 其明日，卜言台周入右屯，攻五日夜。

translations.literal: The next day Buyan Taiju entered You Tun and attacked for five days and nights.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Buyan Taiju attacked You Tun for five days and nights.

sentences.zh: 守廉等固守，乃引去。

translations.literal: Shoulian and the others held firm in defense, and the bandits then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Shoulian held firm, and the enemy finally withdrew.

sentences.zh: 時二十二年十月也。

translations.literal: This was in the tenth month of the twenty-second year.
translations.idiomatic: This was in the tenth month of the twenty-second year of Wanli.

sentences.zh: 捷聞，帝大喜，祭告郊廟，宣捷行賞，進一元左都督，加太子太保，廕本衞世指揮使。

translations.literal: When news of the victory arrived, the emperor was greatly pleased, offered sacrifices at the suburban altars and ancestral temple, proclaimed the victory and distributed rewards, advanced Yiyuan to Left Regional Commander, added the title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and granted hereditary appointment as hereditary commander of his native guard.
translations.idiomatic: When news of the victory arrived, the emperor was overjoyed, offered sacrifices at the suburban altars and ancestral temple, proclaimed the triumph and distributed rewards, promoted Yiyuan to Left Regional Commander with the additional title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and granted a hereditary command in his native guard.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書石星以下亦進秩有差。

translations.literal: The Minister of War Shi Xing and those below him were also advanced in rank to varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The Minister of War Shi Xing and others were also promoted in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 伯言兒最慓悍，諸部倚以為強。

translations.literal: Boyan'er was the fiercest and most ruthless; the various tribes relied on him for their strength.
translations.idiomatic: Boyan'er had been the fiercest of the chieftains; the tribes had relied on him for their strength.

sentences.zh: 嘗誘殺慶雲守備王鳳翔，坐革歲賞。

translations.literal: He had once lured and killed the Qingyun garrison commander Wang Fengxiang, and for this his annual reward was revoked.
translations.idiomatic: He had once lured and killed the Qingyun garrison commander Wang Fengxiang, for which his annual stipend had been revoked.

sentences.zh: 至是被殲，諸部為奪氣，其部下遂納款。

translations.literal: When he was destroyed on this occasion, the various tribes lost their spirit, and his followers then submitted.
translations.idiomatic: His destruction broke the tribes' morale, and his followers submitted.

sentences.zh: 把兔兒、炒花及卜言台周、瓜兔兒、歹青復臨邊駐牧，期以明年正月略遼、瀋東西。

translations.literal: Batuer, Chaohua, Buyan Taiju, Guatu'er, and Daiqing again pressed close to the frontier to pasture their herds, planning to raid east and west of Liaoyang and Shenyang in the first month of the following year.
translations.idiomatic: Batuer, Chaohua, Buyan Taiju, Guatu'er, and Daiqing again camped along the frontier, planning a major raid east and west of Liaoyang and Shenyang in the first month of the coming year.

sentences.zh: 一元慮歲晏不備，為寇所乘，乃先西巡以遏其鋒。

translations.literal: Yiyuan feared that at year's end they would be unprepared and the bandits would take advantage, and therefore made a western tour first to blunt their momentum.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing a year-end raid while defenses were slack, Yiyuan launched a preemptive western campaign.

sentences.zh: 化龍亦留弱卒廣寧，數西發以疑寇。

translations.literal: Hualong also left weak troops at Guangning and sent out several western detachments to confuse the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Hualong left weak troops at Guangning and sent out several western detachments to confuse the enemy.

sentences.zh: 一元提健卒，踏冰渡河，監軍楊鎬與之俱。

translations.literal: Yiyuan led picked troops, crossed the river on the ice, and the supervising commander Yang Hao went with him.
translations.idiomatic: Yiyuan led picked troops across the frozen river, accompanied by the supervising commander Yang Hao.

sentences.zh: 度墨山，天大雪，將士氣益奮。

translations.literal: They crossed Mo Mountain; heaven sent down great snow, and the officers and soldiers grew ever more spirited.
translations.idiomatic: They crossed Mo Mountain in heavy snow, and the troops' spirits rose.

sentences.zh: 行四百里，三日夜乃抵其巢。

translations.literal: They marched four hundred li and after three days and nights reached the enemy lair.
translations.idiomatic: After a march of four hundred li over three days and nights they reached the enemy camp.

sentences.zh: 斬首百二十級，獲牛馬甲仗無算，全師而還。

translations.literal: They beheaded a hundred and twenty, captured cattle, horses, armor, and weapons beyond counting, and returned with the whole army intact.
translations.idiomatic: They took a hundred and twenty heads and countless cattle, horses, armor, and weapons, and returned without losing a man.

sentences.zh: 把兔兒以鎮武創重，歎曰：「我竟不獲報父讐乎？」

translations.literal: Batuer, because of his heavy wound at Zhenwu, sighed and said, "Shall I never obtain revenge for my father?
translations.idiomatic: Badly wounded at Zhenwu, Batuer sighed, "Shall I never avenge my father?

sentences.zh: 未幾死，其衆散亂，諸部悉遠遁。

translations.literal: Before long he died; his followers scattered in disorder, and all the tribes fled far away.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon afterward; his followers scattered, and the tribes fled far away.

sentences.zh: 一元以功進世廕二秩。

translations.literal: Yiyuan was advanced two ranks in hereditary privilege for his merit.
translations.idiomatic: Yiyuan was granted two additional ranks of hereditary privilege for this campaign.

sentences.zh: 久之，以病歸，命王保代。

translations.literal: After a long while he returned home on grounds of illness, and Wang Bao was ordered to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: Eventually he retired on grounds of illness, and Wang Bao was appointed to replace him.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮再用師，詔一元隸總督邢玠麾下，參贊軍事。

translations.literal: When troops were again sent to Korea, an edict ordered Yiyuan to serve under Governor-General Xing Jie and assist in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When troops were again sent to Korea, Yiyuan was ordered to serve under Governor-General Xing Jie as military adviser.

sentences.zh: 尋代李如梅為禦倭總兵官。

translations.literal: Soon he replaced Li Rumei as commander-in-chief against the Japanese pirates.
translations.idiomatic: He soon succeeded Li Rumei as commander-in-chief against the Japanese.

sentences.zh: 時兵分四路。

translations.literal: At the time the army was divided into four routes.
translations.idiomatic: The army was divided into four columns.

sentences.zh: 一元由中路，禦石曼子於泗州，先拔晉州，下望晉，乘勝濟江，連毀永春、昆陽二寨。

translations.literal: Yiyuan took the central route, opposed Ishimanji at Sizhou, first captured Jinzhou, descended on Wangjin, crossed the river in the momentum of victory, and in succession destroyed the two stockades of Yongchun and Kunyang.
translations.idiomatic: Yiyuan took the central route against Ishimanji at Sizhou, captured Jinzhou, advanced on Wangjin, crossed the river in pursuit, and destroyed the stockades at Yongchun and Kunyang.

sentences.zh: 賊退保泗州老營，攻下之，遊擊盧得功陣歿。

translations.literal: The bandits retreated to defend the old camp at Sizhou; it was taken by assault, and the mobile corps commander Lu Degong died in the battle line.
